content.user_title: Check Amazon Listing Drafts for Text Issues
content.value_statement: Amazon listing drafts can contain excessive length, repetitive terms, and unsupported claims. This skill checks supplied text locally and suggests factual revisions for human review.
actual_capabilities: Flag missing titles and titles exceeding the checker's fixed 200-character threshold.
Report when the supplied bullet count differs from five.
Measure backend search terms in UTF-8 bytes and flag values above 249 bytes.
Flag selected guarantee, medical, superlative, and comparison terms using case-insensitive patterns.
Identify alphanumeric terms longer than three characters that occur at least four times within a field.
Check main keyword presence in the title, combined bullets, and description, then sort findings by severity.
limitations: Reviews supplied text only; it does not scrape Amazon, inspect accounts, verify product facts, or guarantee ranking outcomes.
The 200-character title, five-bullet, and 249-byte backend checks are fixed assumptions, not current category-specific policy verification.
English wording patterns and ASCII repetition checks can miss problematic claims or flag acceptable wording; keyword matching uses substrings rather than semantic meaning.
Requires Python 3 and correctly structured JSON input; the script returns findings, while the assistant supplies rewrite suggestions.

use_cases.title: Review a Seller's Draft

use_cases.title: Prioritize Client Copy Revisions
use_cases.description: Use severity-sorted findings to organize factual edits and identify claims requiring client evidence.

use_cases.title: Check Catalog Text Consistency
use_cases.description: Review supplied product drafts individually for bullet counts, repeated terms, and missing main keywords.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Amazon listing: [paste title, bullets, description, and backend terms]. Report findings by severity without adding product facts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Keyword Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this listing for the main keyword [keyword]: [listing text]. Identify missing coverage and suggest natural edits using only verified facts.

prompt_templates.title: Revise and Recheck
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [listing text] using [keyword]. Suggest factual revisions, explain which findings they address, and rerun the checker on the revised text.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Drafts With Policy Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [draft A] and [draft B] separately using [keyword]. Compare findings, preserve [verified facts], and distinguish fixed checks from [provided marketplace rules].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare alternatives with supplied policy references.

output_examples.input: Review a draft with no title, no bullets, an empty description, empty backend terms, and no main keyword.
output: Summary: 1 high finding, 1 medium finding, and 0 low findings.
High: Title is missing. Add a specific, factual product title.
Medium: Found 0 bullets; this check expects 5. Provide five concise, distinct feature bullets.

output_examples.input: Review the title 'Guaranteed best bottle' with five distinct factual bullets, an empty description, empty backend terms, and no main keyword.
output: High: 'Guaranteed' triggers the absolute guarantee wording check.
High: 'best' triggers the superlative or comparison wording check.
Verify these claims against current policy and evidence; replace unsupported claims with facts.

best_practices: Provide all listing fields, the main keyword, and verified product facts before requesting revisions.
Verify flagged claims and fixed thresholds against current marketplace and category rules.
Rerun checks after revisions and measure backend terms in UTF-8 bytes rather than characters.
anti_patterns: Treating an empty findings list as proof of policy compliance or listing approval.
Adding unsupported certifications, medical benefits, guarantees, or comparisons to improve copy.
Forcing keywords into every field or treating substring matches as proof of search relevance.

faq.question: Does this skill access my Amazon account?
faq.answer: No. The bundled script reviews supplied text through standard input and does not access accounts or scrape Amazon.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the title, bullets, description, backend search terms, and optional main keyword. The script expects these as a JSON object.

faq.question: Are the thresholds official current Amazon rules?
faq.answer: The script uses fixed thresholds of 200 title characters, five bullets, and 249 backend bytes. Verify current marketplace and category requirements separately.

faq.question: Does the checker rewrite my listing automatically?
faq.answer: The script produces severity counts, findings, and suggestions. The assistant can propose rewrites, but must preserve verified facts.

faq.question: How does main keyword checking work?
faq.answer: It checks a case-insensitive substring in the title, combined bullets, and description. It does not evaluate synonyms or search rankings.

faq.question: Do I need the linked manual audit service?
faq.answer: No. The local checker does not require that service. The skill includes an optional promotional link; external service terms are separate.
